conviction_note: A full-year print with a new FY27 guide and dividend decision on a name whose post-release sessions have moved a median ~3.8% (actual release dates, 8 prints), so abs_move is set at 3.5. Direction is close to a coin: the FY26 operating beat over the 1.5bn plan is already visible (9M OP 1,368m = 91% progress; Q4 monthly sales +6%) and the single IFIS analyst already sits at 1.7bn. Against that, two release-day items pull in opposite directions. One is a possible extra special dividend: payout at 23 yen falls to about 26-27% if NP beats, and the company topped up the final at the FY25 print. The other is this company's habit of guiding the new year only +6-8% above the prior actual, with a dividend guide that excludes specials (FY24 print -4.4%, FY25 print +0.3%). The findings sum to +0.4 and the scaled number is +0.14 because p_up is held at 52, near 50. Nothing found here is a sourced, unseen number that decides the print.
bar: IFIS consensus via kabuyoho (one analyst) for FY8/2026: sales 64,100m, OP 1,700m, ordinary 1,700m, NP 1,100m; company plan (revised 2026-08-18) sales 63,000m / OP 1,500m / NP 1,000m, dividend 23 yen. https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=2735 and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260818/140120260818522441.pdf. The one-analyst bar does not meet the 'two agreeing sources' rule, so findings that depend on it are capped small. No FY27 consensus is visible anywhere I could reach. print_vs_bar_pct is my estimate of FY26 OP (~1,800m: 9M 1,368m plus a Q4 near last year's 397m on +6% Q4 sales) against the 1,700m bar.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position >=0.5%), unchanged vs prior, as of 2026-09-29 (https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html, from the sealed baseline). Margin ratio (信用倍率) 139x per the baseline and kabutan's quote header on 2026-10-09 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=2735): leveraged retail is heavily long with almost no margin shorts, so there is no squeeze fuel, and the crowded long is the one setup where a disappointing guide finds sellers. The kabutan margin-history page returned a CAPTCHA, so the margin trend is not known. There is no option skew in this market. priced_lean_pct -0.905, almost all of it margin overhang. Run-up -3.34% over 20 days and -0.28% over 5 days; the stock peaked at 748 on 09-08 and has held 712-736 since.

findings.finding: FY8/2026 operating profit is very likely to land well above the 1,500m company plan and modestly above the 1,700m IFIS number. 9M OP was 1,368m (91.2% of plan, against 87.1% and 71.2% at the same point in the prior two years). Q4 all-company sales ran +4.3% / +6.8% / +7.0% in Jun/Jul/Aug with same-store sales +6.8% for the half. Last year's Q4 OP was 397m, while the plan implies only 132m for Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q3 print on 2026-07-09 (9M OP +33.8%) rose +4.66% the next session. The FY25 print on 2025-10-10, where FY OP of 1,419m roughly matched plan, moved +0.31%. The 2026-08-18 NP and dividend revision rose +2.19% the next session (Yahoo daily bars, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/2735.T?range=3y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly it is priced. The 9M result and the monthly series are public, the stock rose from 635 to 723 after the Q3 print, and the lone analyst already sits 13% above the plan. What remains is the gap between my ~1,800m estimate and 1,700m. That gap is uncertain because management kept OP at 1,500m when it revisited the forecast on 2026-08-18 with June and July in hand. If this were fully priced, the IFIS number would already read 1,800m or more.
findings.independence: Q4 sales come from a different document, the 8月度 monthly report (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260904/140120260904532099.pdf). The OP arithmetic rests on the Q3 短信 alone. The company's own 2026-08-18 note says group results are 'robust' (堅調) but leaves OP unchanged, which cuts the other way.

findings.finding: A further special-dividend top-up at the results is plausible. The 23-yen FY26 dividend (15 ordinary + 8 special) was set against NP of 1,000m (payout ~30.5%). If NP lands near the IFIS 1,100m or higher, payout falls to ~26-27%, against 29.2% and 34.8% in the two prior years. The company has precedent: at the FY25 print (2025-10-10) it raised the final from 7.5 to 12.5 yen in a same-day 剰余金の配当 notice. Its stated policy is special dividends 'according to results' and no dividend cuts.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-08-18 dividend raise (12.5 to 15.5 yen final, plus NP) rose +2.19% the next session. The FY25 print that carried the 7.5 to 12.5 final raise moved +0.31%. The 2025-01-10 Q1 print with the 30th-anniversary commemorative dividend rose +6.84%.
findings.why_not_priced: Nobody has announced it, and the yield is quoted on 23 yen everywhere (kabuyoho 3.21%). A top-up is a probability, perhaps one in three, not a known number. Sized as an expectation, not as the event.
findings.independence: The precedent comes from a different document, the FY25 短信 dividend note, which records the final raised to 12.5 yen on 2025-10-10 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251010/140120251007569651.pdf).

findings.finding: This company guides the new year conservatively, and that habit is what the FY27 guide is most likely to show. Initial OP guides were 1,350m (+8.3% over the prior actual) for FY25 and 1,500m (+5.7%) for FY26. Initial dividend guides left out specials: 15 against a prior 20, then 20 against a prior 23. With USD/JPY at ~158 for a fixed-price importer and continuing wage increases, a FY27 guide near FY26 actual +5% and a dividend guide below 23 yen are likely. The removal of Watts Peru's ~131m annual operating loss and September same-store sales of +4.9% (FY27 month 1) partly offset this.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The FY24 print (2024-10-10) guided FY25 OP at +8.3% with a 15-yen dividend against 20 and fell -4.38% the next session. The FY25 print (2025-10-10) guided FY26 OP at +5.7% with a 20-yen dividend against 23 and moved +0.31%.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced, because the habit is visible to anyone who reads the last two 短信. No FY27 consensus is visible, so the bar this guide is judged against is unsourced, and the size is capped small for that reason. A crowded margin long (139x) is the setup in which a conservative guide still finds sellers. If the habit were fully priced, the stock would not trade at its 52-week high zone on a 9.5x company PER.
findings.independence: The FY25 guide habit comes from a separate document, the FY24 短信 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20241010/140120241009595792.pdf). The Peru loss figures, which offset the finding, come from https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260709/140120260708589426.pdf and the September monthly from https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20261006/140120261006546710.pdf.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: FY26 NP and dividend were already revised on 2026-08-18. OP was held at 1,500m against a 1,700m IFIS figure, so the actual comes in above both and is mostly visible. New-year guide: the main event, with no visible consensus; the company habit is +6-8% over the prior actual and a dividend guide that excludes specials. rejected_candidates.detail: The company's own notice calls the earnings impact 軽微 (minor), and the August monthly shows all-company sales +7.0%, so there is no measurable effect to file.
Merged into the guidance finding as an offset. The stock rose on it on 10-07 (kabutan n202610070350).

baseline_tension: Run-up is mildly negative (-3.3% over 20 days) and the lean (-0.9) is almost entirely the 139x margin long. My findings net slightly positive and do not beat the lean with anything unseen. The strongest positive the release could carry is a further special dividend or an ordinary-dividend raise, and I looked for it: there is precedent and a payout gap, but no signal. The strongest negative is a conservative FY27 guide against a crowded margin long.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series, p_up toward 50) is already reflected, because my one negative is about what the release adds (the FY27 guide and dividend guide), not a visible miss, and p_up is already 52. Rule 2 (look for the strongest positive) was done before reading: the dividend top-up is filed as a finding, and only one of three findings is negative.
